author: (Günther, 1860)

note.en: An armoured deepwater searobin from 55 to 550 m, listed by FishBase for Costa Rica and known only from trawls.
note.es: Un rubio acorazado de aguas profundas de 55 a 550 m, listado por FishBase para Costa Rica y conocido solo por arrastres.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic
recWhy: Only a FishBase country listing; deepwater trawl species.

marks.en: Reddish fish covered in bony armour plates with a flat head, short snout and barbels under the chin.
marks.es: Pez rojizo cubierto de placas óseas, con cabeza plana, hocico corto y barbillas bajo la mandíbula.
